text: The height of any point P above the surface of earth is equal to diameter of earth. The value of acceleration due to gravity at point P will be : (Given g = acceleration due to gravity at the surface of earth).
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2022 (Online) 25th June Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
The acceleration due to gravity (g) at a distance (r) from the center of a planet is given by:

$g=\frac{GM}{r^{2}}$

where:

G is the gravitational constant,
M is the mass of the planet,
r is the distance from the center of the planet.

If the height h of a point P above the surface of the Earth is equal to the diameter of the Earth, then the distance r from the center of the Earth to the point P is 3 times the radius of the Earth. Substituting this into the equation for g gives:

$g^{'}=g\left (\frac{R}{3R}\right )^{2}=\frac{g}{9}$

where:

g' is the acceleration due to gravity at the point P,
R is the radius of the Earth.

Therefore, the value of acceleration due to gravity at point P is g/9.
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2022 (Online) 25th June Morning Shift

text: The difference of speed of light in the two media A and $B (v_{A}$ $-$ $v_{B})$ is 2.6 $\times$ $10^{7} m/s$. If the refractive index of medium B is 1.47, then the ratio of refractive index of medium B to medium A is : (Given : speed of light in vacuum c = 3 $\times$ $10^{8} ms^{-1})$
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2022 (Online) 25th June Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Speed of light in a medium $=\frac{c}{n}$

$\Rightarrow$ According to given information,

$\frac{c}{n_{A}}-\frac{c}{n_{B}}=2.6\times 10^{7}$

$\Rightarrow \frac{n_{B}}{n_{A}}-1=\frac{2.6\times 10^{7}}{3\times 10^{8}}\times n_{B}$

$\Rightarrow \frac{n_{B}}{n_{A}}\simeq 1.13$

text: A force on an object of mass 100 g is $\left (10\hat{i}+5\hat{j}\right )$ N. The position of that object at t = 2 s is $\left (a\hat{i}+b\hat{j}\right )$ m after starting from rest. The value of $\frac{a}{b}$ will be $___________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2022 (Online) 25th June Morning Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\vec{F}=m\vec{a}$

$\Rightarrow \vec{a}=100\hat{i}+50\hat{j}$

So, $\vec{S}=\frac{1}{2}\vec{a}t^{2}$

$\frac{1}{2}\left (100\hat{i}+50\hat{j}\right )2^{2}$

$=200\hat{i}+100\hat{j}$ m

so a = 200 m and b = 100 m

so $\frac{a}{b}=2$
